title: Extraction Method A
author: Sarah Siu Tze Mak
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iabcaan
materials: Replace the buffer with fresh buffer.

steps.title: Pre‑digest samples
steps.instruction: Incubate all samples in proteinase K‑containing buffer at 56 °C for 1 hour with rotation in an oven.

steps.title: Second 12‑hour digest
steps.instruction: Add fresh proteinase K buffer to each sample and incubate with rotation in an oven for 12 hours.

steps.title: Purify digests with columns
steps.instruction: Perform phenol:chloroform extraction followed by Qiagen MinElute column purification as detailed below.

substeps.instruction: Mix each digest with 8× modified PB buffer.
Bind the mixture to a MinElute column using reservoirs (as described by Dabney et al. 2013).
Wash the column with 800 µL Qiagen buffer PE.
Elute twice: add 17 µL Qiagen buffer EB, incubate 5 minutes at 37 °C, collect eluate; repeat for a second 17 µL eluate.

steps.title: Analyze extracts on TapeStation
steps.instruction: Load small aliquots of each eluate onto an Agilent 2200 TapeStation HS chip to estimate fragment size distribution and molar concentration.
